questions_and_answers.question_text: Hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn, nín chū mén le ba?

answers.answer_text: I haven't seen you for a long time. You have been away, I suppose?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì a, wǒ yòu dào Guǎngzhōu qu le.

answers.answer_text: Yes, I went to Guǎngzhōu again.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nín wèishénme gāng huílai, yòu qù le ne?

answers.answer_text: Why did you go again when you had just come back from there?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ zhèicì dào Guǎngzhōu qù shi yīnwei wǒ yǒu yíge hěn hǎode péngyou cóng Xiānggǎng lái.

answers.answer_text: This time I went to Guǎngzhōu because I had a very good friend coming there from Hong Kong.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒmen yǒu yìnián méi jiàn le.

answers.answer_text: We had not seen each other for a year.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tā qǐng wo péi ta yìqǐ qù lǚxíng.

answers.answer_text: She asked me to accompany her (in her) travels.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sānge yuè yǐqián wǒ zài Guǎngzhōu, nèige shíhou tā hái bù zhīdào néng bu néng lái.

answers.answer_text: Three months ago, when I was in Guǎngzhōu, she didn't know yet whether she would be able to come or not.
What places did you go to?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nánjīng, Shànghǎi, Hángzhōu, Sūzhōu, dōu qù le. Hángzhōu zhēn shi piàoliang.

answers.answer_text: We went to Nánjīng, Shànghǎi, Hángzhōu, and Sūzhōu. Hángzhōu is really beautiful.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Yǒu jīhui wǒ yào zài qù yícì.

answers.answer_text: If I have the chance, I would like to go again.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèixiē dìfang nǐ dōu qùguo le ba?

answers.answer_text: You have gone to all those places, I suppose?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Méi dōu qùguo. Wǒ hái méi qùguo Sūzhōu.

answers.answer_text: I haven't been to all of them. I still haven't been to Sūzhōu.
to return to one's native country
